annotation.bound_parties_text: Any person who uses a restricted term in connection with the promotion or supply of a road vehicle (or equipment for one) that is not an authorised automated vehicle commits an offence.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: a person commits an offence by using a restricted term in connection with the promotion or supply of a road vehicle, or of a product intended for use as equipment of a road vehicle
annotation.dates_quote: These Regulations may be cited as the Automated Vehicles (Marketing Restrictions) Regulations 2026 and come into force on 7th January 2027.
